content.rendered:
The Hawks View Fun Run will take place on Friday, September 29 (rain or shine) and includes our PreK-5th grade students. This is our largest fundraiser of the year and we appreciate your support! Envelopes and PledgeStar information were sent home last week in backpacks. Families are invited to attend and cheer on their child(ren) from the perimeter of the track. Volunteers with cleared background checks will be  helping inside the track. We will have several check in tables down on the field. Parents should visit one of the tables to sign in and receive a visitor/volunteer sticker. We are looking forward to this fun event! Class running times can be found here.  Volunteer opportunities can be found on the help counter app – each volunteer gets a T-Shirt! 

Please be sure your child is dressed appropriately for the weather.  Wear layers, no open toe shoes, etc.  Don’t forget sunscreen and water bottles!  

For more information, watch our Fun Run video!    Check out the Fun Run prizes here!
